newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BARGE RATES-RATES THINLY QUOTED FOR NEARBYS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BARGE RATES-RATES THINLY QUOTED FOR NEARBYS.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at thin levels on Thursday for the nearby position of next week on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Wednesday.
- One barge, Jeffersonville, Ohio River, next week, bid 90 percent of tariff, no comparison, offer 105 percent, no comparison.
- One barge, Fiber Lift Rake, Pekin, Illinois River, next week, bid 105 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- One barge, Ottawa, Illinois River, next week, no bid, offer 110 percent, no comparison.
